messages:
maria: T-minus 30m before the EU change window. I'm gating the v3.2 rollout behind a short stability gate — want a quick thumbs and any last blockers. Key checks: canary health, p95 latency, embedding token rate.

deploy-bot: DeployBot: started canary rollout v3.2 -> 5% (eu-west1) at 1765432109. Auto-promote=ON by default. Logs: canary_id=cb-1765, snapshot=init.

sam: Looking at dashboards — canary at 5% and healthy so far. p95 ~420ms, error rate 0.1%. No embed cost spike observed. :eyes:

tao: Suggestion: pin fallback to v3.1.4 for dedicated customers and set hard rollback criteria: error_rate > 5% OR p95 > 1200ms sustained 3m. Agree?

ops-lead: Proposal: keep auto-promote OFF for this window and use holdpoints 5% -> 20% -> 50% with manual approvals at each. I'm OOO but oncall for this window.

dave: Ran the smoke bundle against canary: `/smoketest releases/v3.2 --subset=core,embed` -> PASS (all checks green).

natalie: Release notes PR#987 merged. Heads-up: embeddings perf tests showed a small token-rate uptick (~1.02x) with v3.2; we should watch embed_token_rate metric and cache hit ratio.

maria: OK setting a soft hold. @deploy-bot please disable auto-promote beyond 5% until ops gives explicit `approve-rollout`. Also lock pin behavior for dedicated clusters to avoid bleedover.

deploy-bot: Acknowledged. Auto-promotion disabled for canary cb-1765. Manual commands available: 
```
# approve to next stage
deploy-bot approve-rollout 1765432109 stage=20
# emergency rollback to last stable
deploy-bot rollback --to=stable --canary=cb-1765 --reason="manual rollback"
```
Metrics snapshot: errors=0.2%, p95=430ms, rps=120, embed_token_rate=1.02x.

sam: If we need to run emergency rollback from console: `deploy-bot rollback --to=stable` — tested in staging and works.

tao: I'll prepare the pin exemption for embedding-heavy VIPs: pin v3.1.4 on dedicated pools before promotion. Command: `pin --model v3.1.4 --scope=dedicated --note="embeddings fallback"`.

ops-lead: :thumbsup: I'll monitor live. Escalation rules: call rollback if p95 > 1000ms for 5m OR error_rate > 5% any 1m window. Paging oncall at threshold.

maria: Agreement. Last check — post-launch announcement to go after we clear 50% hold. If anything looks off at 20% we stop.

deploy-bot: Canary cb-1765: stable at 5% for 7m. Current metrics: `p95=430ms`, `errors=0.18%`, `embed_token_rate=1.02x`, `cache_hit=87%`. Auto-promote remains OFF.

dave: handing to ops for manual promotion to 20%.

ops-lead: Approving to 20% now — `approve-rollout 1765432109 20%` executed. Monitoring windows open.

maria: Proceed. I'll keep the quiet window watch.

natalie: I'll queue the post-launch monitoring checklist in the Console and ping infra-alerts for dashboards.

sam: Noted. If we need the rollback command quickly: `deploy-bot rollback --to=stable --reason='canary spike'` (copy-paste ready).

ops-lead: Oncall will escalate if thresholds hit. Good to go for now. :white_check_mark:

maria: Thanks all — will post a short launch note once 50% clears.

deploy-bot: Final note: retention of canary logs set to 72h. If you need longer, file ticket.
